fact: The Minister stated that the Integrated Registry Management System (SIGA), implemented in 2017, is in service and that diaspora birth certificate requests are processed digitally from data recorded in SIGA via the DGRN digital portal.
title: Government launches document issuance system at the Embassy of São Tomé and Príncipe in Portugal
publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and Communities (mne.gov.st)
